complexity.explanation: Selection sort has quadratic time complexity in all cases because it always performs n(n-1)/2 comparisons regardless of the initial order. However, it minimizes the number of swaps to at most n-1.

description.brief: A simple comparison-based sorting algorithm that divides the input list into a sorted and an unsorted region. It repeatedly selects the minimum element from the unsorted region and swaps it with the first element of the unsorted region.
detailed: • Best case:    O(n²) - even when array is already sorted
• Average case: O(n²) - always performs n(n-1)/2 comparisons
• Worst case:   O(n²) - maximum number of comparisons
• Performs minimum number of swaps (at most n-1)
• Useful when memory writes are expensive
• Not adaptive - always performs all comparisons
• Comparisons: n(n-1)/2 ≈ O(n²) in all cases
• Swaps: At most n-1 (minimum among O(n²) algorithms)
• Bubble Sort: More swaps but can be adaptive
• Insertion Sort: Better for nearly sorted data
• Selection Sort: Minimal swaps, predictable performance
optimizations: Bidirectional selection sort (also known as cocktail sort)
Heap sort (improved selection using heap data structure)
Stable selection sort variant using insertion
use_cases: When memory writes are expensive (flash memory, EEPROM)
When minimizing swap operations is critical
Educational purposes to demonstrate selection concept
When array is mostly sorted in reverse (still O(n²) but minimal swaps)
disadvantages: Always O(n²) time complexity, even on sorted data
Not stable (relative order of equal elements may change)
Not adaptive - doesn't take advantage of existing order
More comparisons than insertion sort in practice

variables.name: i
variables.description: Marks the boundary between sorted (left) and unsorted (right) portions. Elements before i are already sorted.

variables.name: j
variables.description: Current scanning position within the unsorted portion looking for the minimum element.

variables.name: min_idx
variables.description: Index of the current minimum element found in the unsorted portion during scanning.

variables.name: min_value
variables.description: Current minimum value found during scanning (displayed for clarity).

variables.name: comparisons
variables.description: Total number of element comparisons performed so far.

variables.name: swaps
variables.description: Total number of element swaps performed so far.

variables.name: sorted_count
variables.description: Number of elements that are already in their final sorted position.

variables.name: selected_for_swap
variables.description: Indicates whether the current element at boundary will be swapped with the minimum found.

step_types.name: Outer Loop
step_types.description: Beginning of a new pass - moving boundary forward

step_types.name: Minimum Selected
step_types.description: Initial minimum element selected at current boundary

step_types.name: Inner Loop
step_types.description: Scanning through unsorted portion to find minimum

step_types.name: Comparison
step_types.description: Comparing current element with current minimum

step_types.name: Swap
step_types.description: Swapping boundary element with the minimum element found

step_types.name: No Swap
step_types.description: Minimum already at correct position, no swap needed

step_types.name: Pass Complete
step_types.description: Completed one selection pass - one element placed in sorted position

step_types.name: Completed
step_types.description: Algorithm completed - array is fully sorted

init.description_template: Initializing Selection Sort algorithm on array of size {size}

outer_loop.description_template: Starting outer loop iteration i = {i}. Sorted portion: indices [0, {i-1}], unsorted: [{i}, {n-1}]

inner_loop.description_template: Starting inner loop iteration i = {i}, j = {j}

compare.description_template: Comparing arr[{j}] = {arr[j]} with current minimum arr[{min_idx}] = {arr[min_idx]}

update_min.description_template: Found new minimum! Updating min_idx from {old_min_idx} to {j} (value {arr[j]} < {arr[old_min_idx]})

swap.description_template: Swapping arr[{i}] ({arr[i]}) with arr[{min_idx}] ({arr[min_idx]}) - placing minimum at boundary

no_swap.description_template: Minimum already at position {i}, no swap needed

pass_complete.description_template: Pass {i} complete. Element at position {i} is now in its final sorted position (value {arr[i]}). Sorted count = {sorted_count}

completed.description_template: Selection Sort completed! Array fully sorted after {comparisons} comparisons and {swaps} swaps.
